system.name: ActuPrice Auto Premium Model
system.intended_purpose: Estimate expected claims cost per auto-insurance applicant to inform the rating engine's base premium, subject to filed-rate constraints.
system.deployment_context: Batch scoring nightly plus on-demand quote API; outputs feed a rules-based rating engine with regulatory caps.

policies: NAIC Model Bulletin on AI use by insurers
governance.oversight: Actuaries review feature contributions and approve every rate filing; consumers may request an adverse-action explanation and human review.

out_of_scope: Use of prohibited or proxy variables for protected classes
risks: Proxy discrimination via correlated non-driving variables
Regulatory rejection of unexplained feature effects

measure.test_data: Out-of-time holdout of three policy years with developed losses, excluding any directly protected attributes from the feature set.
limitations: Telematics features unavailable for ~30% of new applicants

mitigations: Disparate-impact testing on each candidate model before filing
Feature-effect monotonicity constraints reviewed by actuaries
